WikiKGExtractorLocalNamespaces.description: Namespace IDs read directly from the current wiki. Namespace 0 is normal content pages.

WikiKGExtractorMaxSourcePages.description: Hard maximum number of broad crop pages accepted per extraction.

WikiKGExtractorMaxCollectedPages.description: Hard maximum number of species and variety pages collected per extraction.

WikiKGExtractorMaxPageChars.description: Hard maximum source wikitext size accepted for one page.

WikiKGExtractorOutputDirectory.description: Export directory. Empty uses the OS temporary directory after checking it is outside the document root.

WikiKGExtractorOutputBaseUrl.description: Optional public base URL. Empty keeps generated exports private.

WikiKGExtractorEnableKG.description: Allow the Special page to invoke the Python KG worker.

WikiKGExtractorPythonCommand.description: Python executable used for the KG worker.

WikiKGExtractorGeminiApiKey.description: Gemini API key. Prefer getenv('GEMINI_API_KEY') in LocalSettings.php. Empty falls back to the rule-based extractor.

WikiKGExtractorGeminiModel.description: Gemini model passed to the KG worker.

WikiKGExtractorKgBatchSize.description: Number of wiki pages sent to the model in one request.

WikiKGExtractorKgTimeout.description: Maximum KG worker runtime in seconds.

WikiKGExtractorPushToNeo4j.description: Write the generated graph straight into Neo4j after each run.

WikiKGExtractorNeo4jPassword.description: Neo4j password. Prefer getenv('NEO4J_PASSWORD') in LocalSettings.php.
